description: Schannel S1 (HTTPS) VM gate: crypt32 authroot work plus the filled schannel SSP tables, OFFLINE guest with a local TLS server inside the guest (tlspoc identity, TLS1.2/1.3). Taken over from Phyllis (paused); items 2 and 3 of her branch rebased on 36a28891bae + Stanley's crypt32-authroot chain; her item 1 dropped as a duplicate of 97bd20bf (Root aggregates AuthRoot, read-only, caller location).
commits: 428ae99443 crypt32: reject partial certificate chains under the SSL chain policy (Stanley)
f2a2d26971 crypt32: honor hExclusiveRoot in a Windows 7-sized chain engine config (Stanley)
51fb48cc50 [CRYPT32] Aggregate AuthRoot into the logical Root system store (Stanley 97bd20bf, replaces Phyllis de6b9b65db)
c4020cd0cb [CRYPT32_APITEST] Import advapi32 for the generated test certificates (64616ad1)
aece1b59d4 [CRYPT32_APITEST] Register the CertOpenSystemStore test with START_TEST (3fa0ffcf)
ad4d1e994d [CRYPT32_APITEST] Pin exclusive-root chain-engine trust semantics (Phyllis 10c420811c, item 2)
4ef505c8db [SCHANNEL] Fill the SSP dispatch tables with adapters over secur32 (Phyllis f4f272bf91, item 3)

build.config: LiberNT CI amd64 clang config with ROSTESTS for the test targets
build.syntax_check: -fsyntax-only with the real amd64-debug flags: rc 0 for schannel adapters/lsamode/usermode and crypt32 store/chain; the two apitests with the crypt32 flags plus the apitest include dir: rc 0. Compiled by syntax only here.

tools.src: tools/src (sources; the certificate is a test-only identity)
tools.note: Prebuilt on the host by Phyllis; rebuild from tools/src if preferred. crypt32.dll, schannel.dll and the two test exes are NOT provided: use the lab build of this branch so no stale binary is used.

vm.mode: OFFLINE guest, no external network. The server runs inside the guest on 10.0.2.15:4443 and gate.cmd adds '10.0.2.15 tlspoc.local' to hosts. Read-only vvfat payload drive with the freshly built crypt32.dll, schannel.dll, crypt32_apitest.exe, schannel_winetest.exe plus tools/*.

steps: apply the bundle, build the four targets, record sha256
payload = built dlls and tests + tools/ (gate.cmd unchanged)

boot a fresh overlay of the 36a28891bae image, run gate.cmd: it starts the server, installs the test CA into ROOT via s0probe, runs s0winhttp WITHOUT ignore flags, then crypt32_apitest and schannel_winetest, and writes s1-result.txt ending with '=== GATE DONE'
pass: s0winhttp https://tlspoc.local:4443 returns HTTP 200 with no ignore flags (baseline: 12157 ERROR_WINHTTP_SECURE_CHANNEL_ERROR)
crypt32_apitest: CertOpenSystemStore and CertCreateChainEngine run (not skipped) with 0 failures; the exclusive-root leaf chain reports error 0x0 and SSL policy 0x0
schannel_winetest: no new failures versus the 36a28891bae baseline (run the baseline winetest in the same image first for the numbers)
if_12157_remains: report the exact gle and the s0server log line ('handshake ok: TLSv1.2/1.3' means the failure is post-handshake certificate policy: report the trust/policy error bits from s0winhttp and the s0probe census of ROOT/AuthRoot). Do not widen trust to make it pass.
report_back: s1-result.txt in full, crypt32.dll and schannel.dll sha256, apitest and winetest summary lines, comparison with the baseline winetest numbers
